WindTrainer_HasStyle.Text: You already carry a Breathing. I will not teach over it.

WindTrainer_Doing.Text: You look like you want to quit. Prove me wrong.

WindTrainer_Done2.Text: Now go make some noise out there. Do not embarrass me.

WindTrainer_Done.Text: Hah. You did not hold back. [A storm that does not stop.]<Style=Rainbow> That is ['Wind Breathing']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

WindTrainer_NoAccess.Text: Breathing is not in you. Seek a different kind of teacher.

Wind Trainer Saneri.Text: Tch. Another one who thinks Wind Breathing is just swinging fast.

WindTrainer_2.Text: It is cutting through anything in your way, hesitation included. Do not waste my time.

Ginzo_Offer2.Text: Bring it back, and we'll talk.

Ginzo_Offer.Text: But first, retrieve my Jewelry Box from my home in the Village Hidden in the Mist.

Ginzo_Buy.Text: Scrap and thread. Every forge wants both, and nobody wants to go digging for them.

Ginzo_Nothing.Text: You have not picked anything out yet.

Ginzo_NoSale.Text: Hm. Nothing there I can pay for.

Ginzo_Thanks.Text: Excellent. That's exactly what I was looking for.

Ginzo_Bye.Text: Come back when your pockets are heavier.

Ginzo.Text: I'll buy whatever you're selling, human or otherwise. Business is business.

Muzan_4.Text: [Become a demon.]<Style=Fade,Color=(1,.3,.3)> Shed that fragile, dying shell and become [eternal.]<Style=Fade,Color=(.8,.7,1)>

Muzan_2.Text: Every kill. Every cruelty. [Every quiet step you've taken deeper into the dark, I was there, watching it bloom.]<Style=Fade,Color=(.8,.7,1)>

Muzan.Text: [I have watched you since the day you drew your first breath into this rotten world.]<Style=Fade,Color=(.8,.7,1)>

Muzan_HasBell.Text: You already carry my gift. [Ring it when the night is deep.]<Style=Fade,Color=(.8,.7,1)>

Muzan_3.Text: You were never meant for their world of [slayers]<Color=(1,.3,.3)> and hollow justice.

Muzan_5.Text: Use this ["Biwa Bell"]<Color=(1,.85,.3)> to travel to my lair.

Muzan_Demon.Text: You bear my blood already. [Do not waste it.]<Style=Fade,Color=(1,.3,.3)>

CompletionNotify.Text: Ah, you found it! Awesome, thanks kid. Here's a little something for your time.
Wow... you actually did it. Alright kid, you've earned yourself a bet. Come talk to me.

Jeso_Successor3.Text: I'll not make a story of him this time either. But he'd be glad it came up, and gladder who has it.

Jeso_Price.Text: The basic one runs [3,500]<Color=(1,1,1)> [#]<img=119954170187936>. Honest price, and I'll not budge on it.

Fisherman Jeso.Text: Well now. Come to buy a rod off an old man, have you?

Jeso_Isao4.Text: And half those nights he'd hang none of it. Bare hook, bare line, hours of it.

Jeso_Isao3.Text: And when I did open, line was the only thing he ever bought off me.

Jeso_Isao5b.Text: Five casts in one spot, never a sixth. Said the sixth was greed.

Jeso_Isao2.Text: He fished this harbor before I'd sold a single rod. Better than me.

Jeso_Pairing2.Text: The rod decides what's on it.

Jeso_BaitTip.Text: Worms pull up weed and small fry, and plenty of both. The rare bites want better than a worm.

Jeso_SendToSofen.Text: Go see ['Dock Master Sofen']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> about the stamp, and mind your manners with him. Then come back to me.

Jeso_Isao2b.Text: Better than ['Angler Runo']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>, and Runo will not hear that said.

Jeso_Isao3b.Text: Made his own hooks, his own lures, every piece of it.

Jeso_Isao6.Text: Something took his line one night, and he would not let go of it. That's the whole of it.

Jeso_Waiting.Text: No stamp on you yet, young one. These eyes are old, not blind.

Jeso_RarePitch.Text: The rare rod I'll not sell for coin. Any fool can buy a rod. Not every fool can fish.

Jeso_Successor.Text: Well now. That rod worked this water before I had a shop, and I'd still know it anywhere.

Jeso_PurchaseFail.Text: Come back when the purse is heavier, young one. I'm not going anywhere.

Jeso_Regulations.Text: I'd hand you one gladly, but the village won't have it. Permits, they want now. Paper, for water.

Jeso_Approved.Text: There we are. Stamped and proper. Now the old man can do business with you.

Jeso_Pairing4.Text: And the ['Golden Tentacle']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> pulls the deep things up. Only the ['Legendary Fishing Rod']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> will hold them.

Jeso_Successor2.Text: His own make, handle to hook. Once I opened, the only thing he ever took off my shelf was line for it.

Jeso_Isao7.Text: And I'll not have you out on that water hunting whatever it was. Buy a worm and be sensible.

Jeso_Pairing2b.Text: Rich bait on that ['Basic Fishing Rod']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> will keep you hauling all day, and it'll be small fry all day.

Jeso_Isao4b.Text: Said bait was for men who wanted the fish.

Jeso_Pairing.Text: Sit a moment, this one's worth the hearing. Bait decides how often the line comes back full.

Jeso_Isao.Text: Ah. I'll not make a story out of a man's last day, young one.

Jeso_Pairing3.Text: On the ['Rare Fishing Rod']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>, now, a ['Fish Head']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. That's the rung where good bait starts paying you back.

Jeso_Pairing5.Text: I watched a line go once, hands and all.

Jeso_BaitShopIntro.Text: Worms. Dug them fresh this morning, so don't go turning your nose up.

Jeso_Isao5.Text: Every fisherman's got his nonsense, and his was counting.

Jeso_PurchaseSuccess.Text: She'll serve you well. Mind the line, and don't yank her.

Jeso_RarePurchaseSuccess.Text: ['Golden Fish']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> on my counter at last. You've earned her, young one.

Alchemist Meku_2.Text: Take a look, they are [high quality]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>.

Kuro_2.Text: Here's my [inventory]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>, buy what you think you need.

Kuro_Farewell.Text: Keep your coin [#]<img=119954170187936> close… we may meet again [when the moon rises.]<Style=Fade,Color=(.6,.6,1)>

Kuro.Text: Well now... not many travelers find me out here [after dark]<Style=Fade,Color=(.6,.6,1)>.

Runo_Waiting.Text: The sea keeps its own hours. Load whatever you land straight into the crate.

Runo_Successor3.Text: Now it's back on my dock in somebody else's hands. Crate still wants filling.

Runo_CatchShort.Text: Twelve of the everyday, and one each of the pretty pair. I'll know if you're short.

Runo_Bigger2.Text: A proper crate. Same everyday fish, more of them, and two of the pretty ones.

Runo_Bigger.Text: There is, once you've fished these waters a while.

Runo_Deep2.Text: ['Crustadon']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. ['Krathulon']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. The water gives one up when it feels like it, and not before.

Runo_CatchThanks2.Text: Forty years and I still can't tell you why they bite some days and not others.

Runo_4.Text: Two of each thing that bites out there. Think you've the patience?

Runo_Deep.Text: There's things down there I've no crate for.

Runo_NoPermit.Text: No permit, no rod, and the fish don't care either way.

Runo_Thanks2.Text: You've got more patience than most fishermen I know.

Runo_Bigger4.Text: Hold onto any ['Golden Fish']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> though. ['Fisherman Jeso']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> trades those for the better rod. Don't waste one on me.

Runo_Deep3.Text: Don't sell them. Not to ['Ginzo']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>, not to anyone.

Runo_NoPermit3.Text: Come back with a line in your hand and we'll talk.

Runo_CatchReturn.Text: Now that's a crate. [Twelve and the two]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>.

Runo_NoPermit2.Text: See the ['Dock Master Sofen']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> first. Then ['Fisherman Jeso']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>, for the rod.

Runo_Successor2.Text: Twenty years I fished beside that man, and never once out-caught him.

Runo_Bigger3b.Text: They come up rare on that line of yours, so don't go hunting them. Just keep what surfaces.

Angler Runo.Text: Ah. A fresh face on my dock.

Runo_CatchThanks.Text: The market'll talk about this one.

Runo_Return.Text: Crate's full. [All eight]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>, and not one gone soft.

Runo_Deep4.Text: You'll know why, or you won't. Keep them either way.

Runo_Thanks3.Text: The village eats tonight. Come find me when the water's calm again.

Runo_2.Text: Forty years I've pulled this harbor's supper out of the water.

Runo_Short.Text: Crate's not full yet. Two of each, and I'll know if you're short.

Runo_3.Text: My hands have gone stiff on me. The crate still wants filling.

Runo_CatchWaiting.Text: Still short. The pretty ones surface when they feel like it. Keep the line out.

Runo_CatchThanks3.Text: And you still brought them in. That's the whole trade.

Sofen_Closed2.Text: His permit's struck. Closed the file, and wrote your name under his.

Sofen_LedgerBroke.Text: Coin first. The drawer's waited this long, it can wait on you.

Sofen_Ledger2.Text: One other man ever brought a pair like that onto my dock.

Sofen_Rumour.Text: The woman with the bandaged hands? You are not the first to ask. I stamped her out.

Sofen_LedgerDone3.Text: On the rock ledge across from the water spout. That's where you'd have found him, any night you cared to look.

Sofen_Closed3.Text: Means nothing to the water. Means a great deal to my ledger.

Sofen_LedgerDone.Text: Isao. That's the name on it, for what it's worth to you.

Sofen_Offer2.Text: Too many people take rods out onto the water and leave broken lines, lost hooks and damaged nets behind.

Sofen_Offer.Text: I can issue one, but not for free.

Sofen_Done.Text: Your permit's in order. Keep the water clean and we'll have no trouble.

Sofen_Thanks3.Text: Show it to the fisherman, and he'll know you're approved.

Sofen_Offer3.Text: If you want a permit, you'll have to show you're willing to help maintain the docks.

Sofen_Ledger2b.Text: He went out again that same week, and I never stamped him back in.

Sofen_Waiting.Text: Still no stamp? The docks aren't going to fix themselves.

Sofen_Rumour2.Text: North, to ['Iceveil Valley']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. Paid the carter twice over. She was shaking too badly to count.

Sofen_Rumour3.Text: Said someone up there had dug her out of a drift once already. A man who makes his living off what he catches in the snow.

Sofen_Offer4.Text: Pay me [5,000]<Color=(1,1,1)> [#]<img=119954170187936> and find the ["Lost Permit Stamp"]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>.

Sofen_Offer5.Text: Last I heard, it was left somewhere around the docks.

Sofen_Ledger3.Text: Nobody ever told me. So his permit sits open in my ledger. Twenty years of a drawer I can't close.

Sofen_LedgerDone2.Text: He fished the same stretch every night of his life. Up the gorge beside the red bridge.

Sofen_Ledger.Text: Hold there. Those two you're carrying.

Sofen_LedgerDone4.Text: What you want with a dead man's fishing spot is your business. I only keep the ledger.

Sofen_Ledger4.Text: [2,500]<Color=(1,1,1)> [#]<img=119954170187936> and I'll read you what's on his file. Records cost the same whether the man's alive or not.

CompletionNotify.Text: It's over?! I can finally go find my ring!

Raze.Text: I sell the best katanas in town, take a look around!

Rin.Text: [Beast Born Demons]<Color=(1,.3,.3)> are closing in on the harbor again tonight.

Rin_Doing.Text: The demons are still out there. Please hurry.

Rin_2.Text: Please, [clear them out]<Style=Fade,Color=(1,.3,.3)> before anyone gets hurt.

Rin_Day.Text: They only come with the dark. Find me again after sundown.

Isao_Owed3.Text: Two ['Crustadon']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>, two ['Krathulon']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. That's what took me, and that's what the water's owed.

Isao_Short2.Text: Two of each. That's what took me, and that's what the water's owed.

Isao_4.Text: Nothing from you. There's a debt to the water in my name, and twenty years haven't paid it.

Legendary Fisherman Isao.Text: That's my lure in your hand.

Isao_Toll2.Text: My rod's on the bottom, downriver of where I worked. Past two drops.

Isao_Toll4.Text: Raise it and keep it. I've no hands left for a rod.

Isao_2.Text: I went down with it, twenty years back. Never came up.

Isao_Short.Text: That's my lure in your hand.

Isao_Toll3.Text: There's a tree grown out over the ledge there. That's where I went in.

Isao_Toll6.Text: But the rod won't rise for someone trying to catch a fish. That was always my trouble.

Isao_Owed2.Text: I went down with it, twenty years back. Never came up.

Isao_3.Text: And you've brought what took me. Two ['Crustadon']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>, two ['Krathulon']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

Isao_Toll7.Text: Anything you pull up out there is the water telling you no. Anything at all.

Isao_5.Text: Settle it, and I'll tell you where my rod went down.

Isao_Owed.Text: That's my lure in your hand.

Isao_Paid.Text: The water's been paid, and I've nothing new to say.

Isao_Paid2.Text: Downriver of where I worked. Past two drops, the tree over the ledge. It hasn't moved.

WaterTrainer_Done2.Text: You have earned the right to call yourself a Water Breather. Do not dishonor it.

WaterTrainer_2.Text: Water does not fight the rock in its path. It wears it down. Prove to me that your resolve is fluid, not brittle.

WaterTrainer_Doing.Text: Your form is still stiff. Return when it flows.

WaterTrainer_Done.Text: You beat Sabito. [Fluid, not brittle.]<Style=Rainbow> That is ['Water Breathing']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

WaterTrainer_HasStyle.Text: You already carry a Breathing. I will not teach over it.

Water Trainer Urokodaki.Text: So. You want to learn Water Breathing.

WaterTrainer_NoAccess.Text: Breathing is not in you. Seek a different kind of teacher.

Ill help clear them out.Hint: They pass for villagers. Nothing will point them out for you.

CompletionNotify.Text: You've done us a great service. Please, take this reward.

Lamplighter Isamu.Text: Mind the floor. Those plates were laid by the lamplighters before me, and they still keep count.

Lantern_3.Text: Five rounds. Each adds a plate to the last, and the lights come quicker the further you get.

Lantern_2.Text: They light in an order. Hold it in your head, then walk it back. Jump from plate to plate, and land square.

Lantern_Doing.Text: The floor is lit. Eyes down, and jump clean.

Lantern_Done.Text: You walked every round. The ['drawings']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> are yours, and I only draw them once.

Lantern_4.Text: Miss one and the whole floor goes dark, and you start over from the first. Walk all five, and I will draw you what the old keepers carried.

Wagasa_4.Text: Slowly. Every rib comes off the same stone. One ground short and the whole thing opens crooked, and it never sits true again after.

Wagasa_7.Text: You carried a rock up a mountain to ask me. I'd say you could. Let me put the order of it on paper while it is in my head.

Wagasa_2.Text: Nobody comes this high. That was rather the point of me stopping here.

Wagasa_Given.Text: Take it to a smith with the scrap, the silk, and the old umbrella you mean to replace. He will want coin for his trouble.

Wagasa_5.Text: The silk goes on wet. It draws tight as it dries and pulls the frame straight for you, if you set the ribs honestly.

Wagasa_Done.Text: You have the ['drawings']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> already. I only wrote them once.

Wagasa Maker Genzo.Text: You pushed a rock the whole way up here. Most of them turn back at the gates.

Wagasa_NoWagasa.Text: Come back when you carry a ['Damascus']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> wagasa. I have nothing to teach a man holding a market piece.

Wagasa_6.Text: You do not forge a new one. You draw the blade off the wagasa you already carry and set it in last, once the canopy is on.

Wagasa_3.Text: Mine. Thirty ribs of hammered ['scrap']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>, folded until they are thin as paper, under a canopy of oiled ['silk']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

Shady Individual_2.Text: They survived encounters that should have killed them.

Shady Individual Rooyi.Text: The Demon King has taken notice of five promising Mizunoto Demon Slayers.

Shady Individual_Thanks.Text: Good job. I see why you were acknowledged.

Shady Individual_3.Text: Before they grow stronger, they must be [eliminated.]<Style=Fade,Color=(1,.3,.3)>

Shady Individual_Doing.Text: Have you gotten rid of the threat yet?

Shady Individual_NotEnough.Text: Five broken blades. Bring me every ['Broken Nichirin Katana']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> they carry.

Niko_Way2.Text: Set your spawn at their crystal while you're down there. Saves you the climb back.

Niko_4.Text: Normally I'd run it down myself, but I'm buried in work.

Niko_Return.Text: Back already. Did it get down there in one piece?

Niko_Way.Text: Head east out of the harbour and follow the river down. The estate sits at the bottom of it.

Niko_5.Text: [It's right here]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>, packed and ready. Mind helping me out?

Niko_Thanks2.Text: There'll be another boat in before long. Come find me.

Niko_3.Text: Medicine, mostly. ['Shiori']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> has been asking after it for a week.

Niko_2.Text: I've got a shipment off the morning boat that needs to go down to the ['Butterfly Estate']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

Niko_Waiting.Text: You've still got the box. Don't keep them waiting.

Niko_Thanks.Text: Looks like it arrived safely. Appreciate the help.

Renjiro_HasStyle.Text: You have a style already. Set it down before you ask for mine.

Tai Chi Expert Renjiro.Text: You came in loud. Everyone does, at first.

Renjiro_Done.Text: You finished. Quietly, which is the part that matters.

Renjiro_Catch.Text: Set them down. I will keep the count.

Renjiro_2.Text: ['Tai Chi']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> is not something I hand over. Earn it, and it will already be yours by the time I say so.

Renjiro_NoCatch.Text: You brought nothing. Notice that before you walk in next time.

Renjiro_Doing.Text: Still forcing it. Come back when you stop.

Renjiro_DoingFish.Text: Still forcing it. Come back when you stop.

Renjiro_Done2.Text: [Yield, then answer.]<Style=Rainbow> That is ['Tai Chi']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. Do not turn it into a hammer.

CompletionNotify.Text: Not bad… You wiped them out.
His guard is thin now… Kaiden is next.

SoundTrainer_Done2.Text: Now go be dazzling. Anything less and I will pretend I never taught you.

SoundTrainer_Done.Text: MAGNIFICENT! An explosive finish! [Flashy is non negotiable.]<Style=Rainbow> That is ['Sound Breathing']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

Sound Trainer Tengai.Text: WELL WELL WELL! Look who wandered in!

SoundTrainer_2.Text: You get to be trained by the flashiest Sound Breather in the Corps. Sound Breathing is a performance: explosive, rhythmic, dazzling. Try to keep up with the beat!

SoundTrainer_NoAccess.Text: Breathing is not in you. Seek a different kind of teacher.

SoundTrainer_Doing.Text: Still going? Good. Feel that rhythm yet?

SoundTrainer_HasStyle.Text: You already carry a Breathing. I will not teach over it.

Cape_Done.Text: I drew it once, and once is what the ['drawings']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> are for. Go and have it made.

Cape_2.Text: When a cape does come back, it comes back wrong. Torn in ways no blade makes. I have been waiting to hold one.

Cape_Offer.Text: That cape. Give it here. I want to draw what it was before the dark got into it.

Weaver Hatsu.Text: I cut cloth for people who walk into the dark. Most of it never comes back.

Cape_Given.Text: There. Every tear, and the line it should have followed. A smith can cut the rest from that.

Cape_NoPiece.Text: That is not the cape. Bring me the cape.

Kazuma_Catch.Text: Hm. They will do. I am keeping count.

Kazuma_HasStyle.Text: You already carry a style. I do not teach over another master's work.

Kazuma_NoCatch.Text: You are holding nothing. Come back with fish.

Kazuma_Done.Text: You've done well. You've proven yourself worthy.

Kazuma_2.Text: I can teach you ['Soryu']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>, but it won't be easy.

Kazuma_Done2.Text: [Earned, not given.]<Style=Rainbow> That is what ['Soryu']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> is. Keep it that way.

Soryu Expert Kazuma.Text: Most people come seeking answers before they've earned them.

Refiner Hagane.Text: Steel remembers every strike. Bring me your weapons and rods, and I will draw more out of them.

Hagane_Forge.Text: Pick a piece, and we will see what the forge says.

Duelist Hibiki.Text: Hear that? No? Then nobody has drawn on me yet today. Stand there and listen a while.

Duel_Done.Text: You carry the ['drawings']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. I drew them once, and once was loud enough. Go and have them made.

Duel_2.Text: These cleavers were mine, and they stay mine until somebody makes me put them down. One on one, nobody steps in, nobody steps out. Just you, me, and the noise.

Yagane_NoIron2.Text: [Crude Iron]<Color=(.31,.73,1)> is issued at [Final Selection]<Color=(1,.3,.3)>. Not here.

Yagane.Text: Armoury. I issue first blades. What do you need?

Yagane_NoIron.Text: No ingot in your kit. Nothing leaves the rack.

Yagane_Forge.Text: Choose a pattern. Same weight, same edge.

Retsu_Back.Text: Once was enough. I've thought on it every winter since, sat here freezing.

Retsu_2.Text: Thirty years I've trapped this valley. Wore the thickest fur there is. Cold still got through.

Retsu_Lantern_2.Text: It grows down in the cave. Small caps, close to the ground.

Retsu_Alive.Text: Couldn't say. Ice like that don't let a thing rot.

Retsu_Riddle.Text: The old folk had a line about it. Said it only wakes for [a heart frozen by eternal winter.]<Style=Fade,Color=(.8,.7,1)>

Retsu_5.Text: Something's standing in the ice inside it. Big, and white, and not one bit of frost gathered on it.

Retsu_Lantern_Broke.Text: Not enough coin. Come back with [2,500]<Color=(1,1,1)> [#]<img=119954170187936>.

Retsu_Lantern_Wearing2.Text: Thirty years I meant to go back for it. Never did.

Retsu_Rumour3.Text: Last I saw her she was headed up to the settlement. Somebody up there sold her a coat.

Retsu_Done.Text: That's the whole of what I know. I trap animals, not riddles.

Old Trapper Retsu.Text: You feel this cold? [Cloth don't stop it.]<Color=(.6,.6,1)>

Retsu_6.Text: The folk who were here before me called it the ["White Terror"]<Color=(.6,.6,1)>.

Retsu_4.Text: There's a fall down there that has never once frozen over.

Retsu_Lantern_3b.Text: My oil was gone by then. Had been gone a while.

Retsu_Where.Text: Not in my traps. A thing like that ends up with them that buy and sell.

Retsu_Lantern_Lit.Text: Put that lamp away if you're asking about mine.

Retsu_Lantern_Told.Text: Southeast, then up. There's a way into the cave near the top.

Retsu_Rumour.Text: Woman come through here. Hands wrapped. Asked me where the snow lay deepest.

Retsu_Rumour2.Text: Pulled her out of a drift the winter before. She went back into the same one.

Retsu_Lantern_Wearing.Text: That's mine. The one I left in the cave.

Retsu_Lantern_3.Text: Saw it shine good one time.

Retsu_Lantern_Price.Text: I can give you the place. Costs you [2,500]<Color=(1,1,1)> [#]<img=119954170187936>.

Retsu_4b.Text: I got in behind it, out of the weather. There's a cave.

Retsu_Alive2.Text: Its chest is open, though. Whatever beat in there was cut out and carried off.

Retsu_3.Text: Saw one thing the cold don't touch. That was years back, down by ['Butterfly Estate']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

Retsu_Lantern.Text: This one ain't got oil in it.

Retsu_Lantern_Told2.Text: Filled my pouch there. Left my old lamp behind.

Rika.Text: My formulas are backed by [science]<Color=(.4,.85,1)>, not superstition. [Pick your potion.]<Style=Fade>

Rika_PurchaseFail.Text: [Unfortunately you don't know what's good for you.]<Color=(1,.3,.3)>

Rika_PurchaseSuccess.Text: A wise selection. May the formula serve you well.

SerpentTrainer_Done.Text: You struck without hesitation, and without wasting a single movement. [The one true opening.]<Style=Rainbow> That is ['Serpent Breathing']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

SerpentTrainer_Done2.Text: You have earned my respect. Do not give me a reason to take it back.

SerpentTrainer_Doing.Text: Coiling tighter each time. Good, that patience will keep you alive.

Serpent Trainer Obari.Text: So. You want to learn the Serpent's way.

SerpentTrainer_2.Text: A serpent does not strike blindly. It waits, it coils, it finds the one true opening.

SerpentTrainer_NoAccess.Text: Breathing is not in you. Seek a different kind of teacher.

SerpentTrainer_HasStyle.Text: You already carry a Breathing. I will not teach over it.

Nori_Tentacle.Text: Comes off something that lives deeper than my line goes.

Baitmonger Nori.Text: Don't know you. Don't sell to strangers.

Nori_Locked2.Text: Word travels, though. ['Shiori']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> at ['Butterfly Estate']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> is short on medicine.

Nori_Tentacle4.Text: Sealed until whatever's ringed around it stops breathing. That part's your problem.

Nori_Tentacle2.Text: Worms and ['Fish Head']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> I'll trade for Wen. That one costs more than coin.

Nori_Shop.Text: Bait for every depth. Take your pick.

Nori_Tentacle3.Text: Or you go take them. A ['Sealed Chest']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> out in the wild will be holding some.

Nori_Locked3.Text: Help her, and I'll know your name by the time you're back.

Nori_Tentacle5.Text: Nothing marks where they sit, and they don't sit long. Rougher the country, the fatter the haul.

Nori_Unlocked.Text: Heard what you did for ['Shiori']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. That's good enough for me.

Statues_3.Text: He said stone only wakes for the thing it was cut to remember. One remembers steel. One remembers breath. One remembers a bare hand.

Stonemason Tobei.Text: Mind where you lean. Half this village is my father's stone, and it remembers who leaned on it.

Statues_Given.Text: He drew these the year he finished them. Take them to a smith, and he will know the rest.

Statues_4.Text: I never asked him. Their eyes are shut, all three. I like to think they are waiting.

Statues_Ready.Text: Their eyes are open. All three. Then you are the one he cut them for.

Statues_2.Text: He cut three warriors before he died. Never told a soul where he stood them, and never went back to look.

Statues_Done.Text: You have the ['drawings']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. There is nothing else of his I can give you.

Mokuro_3b.Text: And they all drill the same palm strike. Take it square and it puts you flat on the ground.

Mokuro_3.Text: If you go down there, they won't wait for you to swing first.

Mokuro_Doing.Text: Watch for the palm. The rest of what they do varies, but that strike is on every one of them.

Mokuro_1b.Text: One rung up from the bottom, and the first the Corps trusts out on its own.

Mokuro_4b.Text: Each one has a technique of their own, so don't assume the second fight will go like the first.

Demon Mokuro.Text: There's a Corps watch camped at the mouth of this cave. [Mizunoe]<Color=(.7,.8,.95)> rank.

Mokuro_4.Text: Past the palm, they're not all alike.

Mokuro_2.Text: They camp a little deeper in every week. Nobody's given them a reason to stop.

Mokuro_5.Text: Kill six of them. It won't end the watch, but it'll push it back out of the cave for a while.

Lynx_Locked.Text: These racks are settlement stock. I cannot sell off them to someone the gate has not let in.

Lynx_2.Text: If you are looking to survive ['Iceveil Valley']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>'s winters, browse the racks. They turn over every hour, so what you see now will not keep.

Lynx_Rumour.Text: The woman with the wrapped hands? She bought the heaviest coat on the rack and went straight back out into the snow.

Winter Store Rep Lynx.Text: Ah, a traveler. Not many make it this far through the snow.

Lynx_Rumour3.Text: Toward the drop, past the last houses. She came back without her shovel and would not say why. If it is still out there, the snow has it.

Lynx_Rumour2.Text: She said she had buried a pair of fans out there and would not leave the valley without them.

Lynx_PurchaseSuccess.Text: A wise purchase. Out here, warmth can mean the difference between life and death.

Lynx_Locked2.Text: Help ['Iceveil Guard Shiro']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> see us through the winter first. Then come and warm up.

Lynx_PurchaseFail.Text: Not enough on you, I am afraid. Come back with a heavier purse -- and mind the racks, they turn over every hour.

StoneTrainer_2.Text: Even the hardest stone is shaped slowly, by water and time. Breathe with me a moment first.

Stone Trainer Gyorei.Text: You have come to train Stone Breathing.

StoneTrainer_HasStyle.Text: You already carry a Breathing. I will not teach over it.

StoneTrainer_NoAccess.Text: Breathing is not in you. Seek a different kind of teacher.

StoneTrainer_Doing.Text: Pain is only stone being shaped. Do not mistake it for failure.

StoneTrainer_Done.Text: You stood against my student and did not waver. [That stillness is the true weight.]<Style=Rainbow> That is ['Stone Breathing']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

StoneTrainer_Done2.Text: Carry it gently. A weight swung carelessly breaks the one holding it.

StoneTrainer_NoWeapon.Text: Stone is not taught to empty hands. Find yourself an ['Axe and Mace']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> first, then we will speak.

CompletionNotify.Text: Eight fewer of them in this valley. That will hold for a while.

Ren_NoBlade.Text: You've come back with nothing. It's still out there, at the foot of the falls.

Ren_Thanks3.Text: I thought I'd never see it again.

Ren_WaitingWhere2.Text: It'll be at the foot of them, on the bank.

Ren_Return.Text: You came back. Please tell me you found it.

Ren_Where3.Text: I'd go myself, but ['Shiori']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> won't have me off the grounds until my head clears.

Ren_GourdSuccess.Text: Fill your lungs with it. That's what it's for.

Ren_Where3b.Text: A slow lap of the lawn is the whole of my day.

Ren_Waiting.Text: That blade means everything to a Demon Slayer.

Ren_WaitingWhere.Text: Go [northwest]<Color=(1,.85,.3)> and keep heading downhill until you meet the river, then follow it to the [falls]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>.

Ren_4.Text: When I woke up, my ['Nichirin Blade']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> was gone.

Ren_Where.Text: The road back from a mission runs up the river gorge, [northwest]<Color=(1,.85,.3)> of here. The bank gave under me.

Ren_5.Text: Can you help me find it?

Ren_Done.Text: Head's still ringing, but I've got my blade back. I won't forget that. The gourds by my post are yours to buy. No slayer should train their breathing dry.

Ren_Where2b.Text: The current only runs one way down there, toward the [falls]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>.

Ren_3.Text: I was returning from a mission when I slipped near the [river]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>.

Ren_Where2.Text: I came round on the stones with the water at my back and my hand empty.

CompletionNotify.Text: You found it! Thank you for bringing it back!

Elara_Welcome.Text: A pleasure doing business with you. Stop by anytime.

Elara_Idle2.Text: If you want my attention, make yourself useful to someone I trust.

Elara.Text: I only do business with a certain caliber of customer. You are not it.

Elara_Thanks2.Text: Anyone who earns that old farmer's trust is welcome in my shop.

Elara_NoPackage.Text: You're not carrying anything for me.

Elara_Idle3.Text: Farmer ['MoldySugar']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> in ['Windy Peak']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> always needs a hand.

Elara_Delivery.Text: ...That ['Package']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. Is that the farmer's handwriting on it?

ThunderTrainer_HasStyle.Text: W-wait, you already have a Breathing? Then you don't need me! Two at once is how people explode.

Thunder Trainer Zentaro.Text: H-hey! Wait, don't... actually, stay! You want to learn something?

ThunderTrainer_NoAccess.Text: Oh. You're not the breathing kind, are you? I, um, can't help with that.

ThunderTrainer_2.Text: ['Thunder Breathing']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>? I'm the fastest thing you'll ever see, promise!

ThunderTrainer_Done.Text: Y-YOU DID IT?! One clean strike, no hesitation.

ThunderTrainer_Doing.Text: You're still here? Good! Keep going!

ThunderTrainer_3.Text: Let's start with some meditation. Easing into terrifying is fine, right?

ThunderTrainer_Done2.Text: [Speed really can make up for everything.]<Style=Rainbow> I've taught you all I know. Go be terrifying!

Goro_4b.Text: They carry two arts each, so don't relax just because you lived through the first one.

Goro_5b.Text: They'll mob anything that steps inside.

Demon Slayer Goro.Text: The cavern behind this fall is crawling with demons.

Goro_2.Text: That's not for lack of looking.

Goro_2b.Text: Every demon down there grew its own blood art in the dark. No two of them fight the same way.

Goro_3.Text: The [Lesser Demons]<Color=(1,.4,.4)> keep to the floor. One art apiece.

Goro_1b.Text: Two kinds, and I can't tell you exactly what either one will throw at you.

Goro_6.Text: Six of the lessers, or seven of the greaters. If you've never been inside, start on the floor.

Goro_GreaterDoing.Text: Only one greater will come at you at a time.

Goro_5c.Text: The greaters come down one at a time, but each one is a harder fight.

Goro_LesserDoing.Text: Watch your back on the floor. The lessers don't take turns.

Goro_GreaterDoing2.Text: Once it's shown you both of its arts, it has nothing left to surprise you with.

Goro_5.Text: One more thing. The lessers are there to keep you off the ledges.

Goro_3b.Text: Once one has shown you its trick, you've seen everything it has.

Shiori_2.Text: Every day injured slayers arrive seeking treatment.

Shiori.Text: We're running dangerously low on medical supplies.

Shiori_FoodNoRod.Text: The shelves are full again, thanks to you. I'd ask one more thing, but you'd need a better fishing rod for it.

Shiori_Rumour.Text: Before you go. A woman came through last month with both hands bandaged to the wrist. Frostbite.

Shiori_FoodThanks2.Text: They'll eat properly this week. That does more for them than half of what's on my shelves.

Shiori_3.Text: Without medicine, I [won't be able to help them]<Color=(1,.3,.3)>.

Shiori_NoBox.Text: You've come back with nothing. ['Estate Worker Niko']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> still has the crate, up at the harbour.

Shiori_Thanks4.Text: ['Baitmonger Nori']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>, up in ['Hidden Mist Village']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. He'll trade with you now.

Shiori_5.Text: ['Health Elixir']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>, ['Health Regen Elixir']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> and ['Stamina Regen Elixir']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

Shiori_FoodCommon.Text: The common catch is thin. It won't put weight back on anyone.

Shiori_Food.Text: The shelves are full again, thanks to you. Now it's the food stores I'm worried about.

Shiori_FoodThanks3.Text: Come find me when the stores run low again.

Shiori_Food3.Text: Without it, they [stay in those beds twice as long]<Color=(1,.3,.3)>.

Shiori_Thanks3.Text: Word of what you did here has already reached the bait dealer.

Shiori_Food6.Text: They run deep, so you'll want ['Baitmonger Nori']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>'s bait for them, up in ['Hidden Mist Village']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

Shiori_Rumour2.Text: She would not say. Only that she had left something in the snow up north and meant to go back for it, hands or no hands.

Shiori_Return.Text: The crates are full again. [All thirty]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>.

Shiori_Food4.Text: Bring me fish. Nine of each kind.

Shiori_FoodNoRod2.Text: ['Fisherman Jeso']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> sells the rod, down on the Mistfall dock, and ['Baitmonger Nori']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> the bait.

Shiori_6.Text: ['Alchemist Meku']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> in ['Mistfall Harbor']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> sells them all.

Shiori_Thanks2.Text: This should keep the infirmary running for a while longer. Thank you.

Shiori_7.Text: Load them into the [infirmary crates]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>, and we can keep treating people.

Shiori_Food7.Text: Load them into the same [crates]<Color=(1,.85,.3)>, and we can get people back on their feet.

Shiori_4.Text: Bring me elixirs. Ten of each kind.

Shiori_Food2.Text: The ones recovering here need more than medicine. They need proper food.

Shiori_FoodWaiting.Text: The crates are still short. Load whatever you bring straight in.

Shiori_FoodCommon2.Text: ['Angler Runo']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> takes those for the village. My patients need better.

Shiori_FoodNoRod3.Text: Come back when you're equipped for it.

Shiori_Box.Text: That's the crate off the harbour boat. I'd almost given up on it.

Shiori_Waiting.Text: The crates are still standing empty. Load whatever you bring straight in.

Shiori_Rumour3.Text: She took the harbour road. Nobody leaves that town without someone writing it down.

Shiori_BoxThanks2.Text: Half of what's in there I've been rationing for a week. Tell ['Estate Worker Niko']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> I said thank you.

Haori_2.Text: There is one seam I never learned. It only turns up on clothes that came back from somewhere they should not have been.

Tailor Omi.Text: Every stitch I know, I learned off a dead man's coat.

Haori_Offer.Text: Those clothes. Set them on the table. The seam is in there, under all of that.

Haori_Done.Text: You carry the ['drawings']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. My hands would not manage them twice.

Haori_NoPiece.Text: My eyes are old, but not that old. Those are not the clothes.

Haori_Given.Text: Fifty years, and there it was. I have put it on paper for you, seam by seam. Find a smith for the rest.

CompletionNotify.Text: You found them... The Book of Guidance is yours.

Black Marketer_Farewell.Text: Keep your coin [#]<img=119954170187936> ready… I move on [before anyone asks questions.]<Style=Fade,Color=(.8,.7,1)>

Black Marketer.Text: You look like someone who understands the [true value]<Color=(.8,.7,1)> of things.

Black Marketer_2.Text: See anything you like? I don't [stay long]<Style=Fade,Color=(1,.3,.3)>.

Jugg.Text: A group of [Blood Hounded Demons]<Color=(1,.3,.3)> has taken over the cave behind me.

Jugg_Doing.Text: Have you gotten rid of the threat yet?

InsectTrainer_Done2.Text: Welcome to the club. Smile more, it unsettles people.

InsectTrainer_2.Text: Insect Breathing is elegance and precision, not brute strength. Do try to keep up.

Insect Trainer Shinora.Text: Oh, how nice. A new little student.

InsectTrainer_Doing.Text: Tired already? That is alright. Just do not let it become a habit.

InsectTrainer_Done.Text: My my, you really did it. [Deadly, and never once looking like it.]<Style=Rainbow> That is ['Insect Breathing']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

InsectTrainer_HasStyle.Text: You already carry a Breathing. I will not teach over it.

InsectTrainer_NoAccess.Text: Breathing is not in you. Seek a different kind of teacher.

Zurinyz_NoCatch.Text: You bring me nothing. Do not make a habit of it.

Harvester of Souls Zurinyz.Text: Most people come seeking answers before they've earned them.

Zurinyz_2.Text: So, you've decided to walk the path of the ['Reaper']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>. Understand this: strength alone will not earn you this fighting style.

Zurinyz_HasStyle.Text: You already walk another path. I will not braid the two.

Zurinyz_Done.Text: You've done well. The scroll, the training, and Kuzan. You've proven yourself worthy.

Zurinyz_3.Text: Before I can teach you, you must prove it. Bring me the catch, the scroll, and my student's defeat.

Zurinyz_Done2.Text: [Nothing wasted. Nothing spared.]<Style=Rainbow> That is what the ['Reaping Blades']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)> are for.

Zurinyz_Catch.Text: Good. The cold will keep them.

FlameTrainer_HasStyle.Text: You already have a Breathing. I will not teach over it.

FlameTrainer_Done.Text: Magnificent! [Burning brighter than fear.]<Style=Rainbow> That is ['Flame Breathing']<Color=rgb(255,176,0)>.

FlameTrainer_2.Text: Let us see if that fire survives training, and my top student.

FlameTrainer_Doing.Text: Still standing? Good. Back to it.

FlameTrainer_Done2.Text: I have taught you all I can. Go, and never let that flame gutter out!

Flame Trainer Rengu.Text: HAH! A new face! I can already see it: there is a fire in your eyes.

FlameTrainer_NoAccess.Text: Breathing is not in you. Seek a different kind of teacher.

CompletionNotify.Text: That's the burning ones done. The harder half of this valley.
The cold's giving ground. Take this, you earned it out there.
